evidence.context:
但远远没有训大师的一句话语,一个调教指令来的刺激,她开始期待起训奴大师的调教。

又是一天的夜晚,这次她没有急着快进观看成人片,而是细细的品味其中的剧情和细节。

程沐云逐渐发现自己对第二部两男一女的性交更感兴趣。那部影片中的女主人公拥有一副极其迷人的身材,她的阴道和肛门都被两个男人尽情地抽插,让两根鸡巴在体内交织成一条流动的河流。最后的场景是插入阴道的男人拔出鸡巴,插着肛门的男主抱着把女主放到床上跪着,那名男主走到女主头部把鸡巴插入女主嘴中,两名男性在插入时的节奏并不完全同步,而是交错进行——先后各自以不同速度推进最后前面的男人先射精,女主口里含着精液,一溜精液浊白挂在女主的嘴角,有着说不出
evidence.match: 性交, 阴道, 精液, 射精

<js>
if(S("@css:.container-fluid:nth-of-type(3)>div>div:nth-of-type(1)>a:nth-of-type(2)@text")=="清单" && !/post/.test(book.bookUrl)){	
	let firstText = S("@class.article-body@class.main-text.0@html");
	let c=S('@class.article-title@class.h5.0@text')?'📖 '+S('@class.h5.0@text')+' 📖\n':"";
//	let head ="\n 【"+S("@class.panel-heading.0@text")+"】";
  let head = /page=1$/.test(baseUrl)?"\n‎\n【评 论】":"";
	result=c+firstText+head;
	
	let posts = java.getElements('@css:div[id^="postbody"]').toArray();
	posts.forEach(x=>{
		   let y = x.html();
		   
		   let head = "\n👤 "+S("@css:.col-xs-12@text",y)
		   .replace(/只看该用户/g,'')
		   .replace(/[RP]\.\d{3,}/g,'');
		   
		   let title =S("@class.text-center@text",y)? "\n📖 "+S("@class.text-center@a@html",y):"";
		   
		   let grayout ="\n"+(S("@css:.grayout.h4 a,.grayout.h4 .fa-star[aria-hidden='true'],.post-reply.grayout@html",y)? "📝 "+S("@css:.grayout.h4 a,.grayout.h4 .fa-star,.post-reply.grayout@html",y):"")
		   .replace(/<i class="fa fa-star.*?<\/i>\s+/g,'⭐️')
		   .replace(/\s*<(?:div|p)/g,'<span')
		   .replace(/<\/(?:div|p)/g,'</span')   
		   .replace(/\s+/g,' ');
		   
		  if(/threads\/\d+/.test(grayout)){
		  	      let href = grayout.match(/href="([^"]+)"/)[1];
		  	      grayout = grayout.replace(/📝/g,getImage("🔗",href))		  			  
		  }
		  		  	   		  			   
		   let body = S('@css:*[id^="full"]@html',y);
		   result += head + grayout + title + body		
		});
        
                     
}else if(/profile/.test(book.bookUrl)){
result = String(java.getString("@class.main-text.0@span@p@html"));
result = result.replace(/<span[^>]+?font-size:0px[^>]+?>[^<]+?<\/span>/gi,'');

a=java.getString('@@class.warning-tag.0@html');
b=java.getString('@css:[class="text-left grayout"]@html');
c=java.getString('//strong[@class="h5"]/text()');
if((!a.match(/<h6/))&&(a!='')&&(!a.match(/>我要签到<\/a/))){
a='作者有话说：\n'+a+'\n————————————\n'
}else{a=''}
if(b!=''){
b='作者有话说：\n'+b
}
result='【'+c+'】\n'+a+result+b
}else{	
	result = java.getString("@css:.col-xs-12 p,.article-title>.h5,.text-center>.h5,.vertical-middle,.majia,.grayout.smaller-30,.grayout.smaller-20,.main-text span[id^='full'],.fa-star[aria-hidden='true'],.post-reply,*[id^=postcomment]@html");
	result=String(result)
	         .replace(/<(?:strong|div) class="h5".*?>\n*([^\n]+)\n*<\/(?:strong|div)>/,'📖 $1 📖')
	         .replace(/<i class="fa fa-star.*?<\/i>\s+/g,'⭐️')
	         .replace(/<span class="(?:majia|vertical-middle)">([^<]+)<\/span>/g,'👤$1')
	         .replace(/<(?:div|span) class="grayout smaller-[32]0">\n*([^\n]+)\n*<\/(?:div|span)>/g,'🕘$1')
	         .replace(/<div class="(?:post-reply grayout|smaller-20)"(?: id="postcomment\d+")*>\n*([^\n*]+)\n*<\/div>/g,'【$1】')	   
	         
	         
	               
	}
if(/(?:threads|posts)\/\d+/.test(result)){
		  let href = result.match(/href=".*?(?:threads|posts)\/\d+.*?"/g);
		  href.forEach(x=>{	  	   
		      let h = x.match(/href="(.*?(?:threads|posts)\/\d+.*?)"/)[1];
		      let r = new RegExp('<a.*?href="'+h+'">','g');
		      result = result.replace(r,"<a>"+getImage("🔗",h))
		   })
	  }	
	
	
result = result.replace(/📖 <a>/g,'<img');
</js>

bookInfoRule.init:
<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + o('.m-book_info p').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>
